H7014B.name: Cain
H7014B.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H7014B.brief: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel
H7014B.short: Cain, the firstborn son of Adam and Eve, murdered his brother Abel and was cursed by God to be a wanderer.

H7040.name: Kallai
H7040.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7040.brief: A priest during the time of Joiakim
H7040.short: Kallai was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, after the Babylonian exile.

H7041.name: Kelaiah
H7041.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7041.brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
H7041.short: Kelaiah, also known as Kelita, was a Levite who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reform.

H7042G.name: Kelita
H7042G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7042G.brief: A Levite who taught the Law and sealed the covenant
H7042G.short: Kelita was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H7055I.name: Kemuel
H7055I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7055I.brief: A Levite leader during David's reign
H7055I.short: Kemuel, the son of Hebron, was the leader of the Levites during the reign of King David.

H7055G.name: Kemuel
H7055G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7055G.brief: A son of Nahor and Milcah
H7055G.short: Kemuel was a son of Nahor and Milcah and the father of Aram.

H7055H.name: Kemuel
H7055H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7055H.brief: A leader from the tribe of Ephraim
H7055H.short: Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan, was a leader from the tribe of Ephraim appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

H7018.name: Kenan
H7018.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H7018.brief: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth
H7018.short: Kenan (Cainan), the son of Enosh, was a descendant of Seth and an ancestor of Noah.

H7073H.name: Kenaz
H7073H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7073H.short: Kenaz was a descendant of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

H7073G.name: Kenaz
H7073G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H7073G.brief: An Edomite clan descended from Esau
H7073G.short: Kenaz was one of the clans of Edom, descended from Esau through his son Eliphaz.

H7073I.name: Kenaz
H7073I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7073I.brief: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel
H7073I.short: Kenaz was the father of Othniel, a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the oppression of Cushan-rishathaim.

H7017.name: Kenites
H7017.brief: A nomadic tribe friendly to the Israelites
H7017.short: The Kenites were a nomadic tribe who lived in the region of Canaan and were generally friendly to the Israelites, often providing them with assistance and support.

H7074G.name: Kenizzites
H7074G.brief: A Canaanite tribe in the Promised Land
H7074G.short: The Kenizzites were one of the Canaanite tribes inhabiting the land God promised to give to Abraham's descendants.

H7026.name: Keros
H7026.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7026.brief: A family of temple servants who returned from exile
H7026.short: Keros was the name of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H7027H.name: Kish
H7027H.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H7027H.brief: A Levite from the Merari clan
H7027H.short: Kish was a Levite from the clan of Merari, whose descendants were assigned duties in the tabernacle service.

H7027G.name: Kish
H7027G.desc: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
H7027G.brief: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel
H7027G.short: Kish was a Benjamite, the father of Saul, who was anointed by Samuel as the first king of Israel.

H7027I.name: Kish
H7027I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7027I.brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
H7027I.short: Kish, a Levite from the clan of Merari, participated in the purification of the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H7027J.name: Kish
H7027J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H7027J.short: Kish, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of Mordecai, the cousin and guardian of Queen Esther.

H7029.name: Kishi
H7029.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H7029.brief: A Levite and father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan')
H7029.short: Kishi, also known as Kushaiah, was a Levite from the clan of Merari and the father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan'), a prominent musician in King David's court.

H7014A.name: Kain
H7014A.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H7014A.short: Kain, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:57">Joshua 15:57</ref>), is possibly associated with the Kenites mentioned in <ref="Numbers 24:22">Numbers 24:22</ref>.

H7056.name: Kamon
H7056.brief: The burial place of Jair, a judge of Israel
H7056.short: Kamon, a city in Gilead where Jair, a judge of Israel, was buried (<ref="Judges 10:5">Judges 10:5</ref>).

H7071G.name: Kanah
H7071G.brief: A brook marking the border between Ephraim and Manasseh
H7071G.short: The Brook of Kanah formed part of the border between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh (<ref="Joshua 16:8; 17:9">Joshua 16:8; 17:9</ref>).

H7071H.name: Kanah
H7071H.brief: Town in Asher's territory; village where Jesus performed miracles
H7071H.short: Kanah was a border town in Asher's territory, while Cana was the village in Galilee where Jesus performed his first miracle.

H7084.name: Keilah
H7084.brief: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David
H7084.short: Keilah, a town in the Shephelah of Judah, was rescued by David from Philistine attack but later threatened to betray him to Saul (<ref="Joshua 15:44; 1Samuel 23">Joshua 15:44; 1Samuel 23</ref>).

H7079.name: Kenath
H7079.brief: A city in Gilead, captured by Nobah and renamed
H7079.short: Kenath, a city in Gilead captured by Nobah and renamed after himself, was later recaptured by Geshur and Aram (<ref="Numbers 32:42; Judges 8:11; 1Ch.2.23">Numbers 32:42; Judges 8:11; 1Ch.2.23</ref>).

H7016.name: Kinah
H7016.brief: A town in the Negev region of Judah
H7016.short: Kinah, a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:22">Joshua 15:22</ref>).

H7024A.name: Kir
H7024A.brief: A Moabite city, later destroyed by the Babylonians
H7024A.short: Kir, also known as Mizpeh, was a Moabite city that faced destruction by the Babylonians (<ref="Isaiah 15:1; Jeremiah 48:1">Isaiah 15:1; Jeremiah 48:1, 23</ref>).

H7024B.name: Kir
H7024B.brief: A city or region in Mesopotamia, possibly Elam
H7024B.short: Kir, a city or region in Mesopotamia, possibly Elam, was the place where the Arameans were exiled and from where they originally came (<ref="2Ki.16.9; Amo.9.7">2Ki.16.9; Amo.9.7</ref>).

H7028.name: Kishon
H7028.short: Kishon, a river in northern Israel, where Deborah and Barak defeated Sisera's army (<ref="Judges 4:7, 13; 5:21">Judges 4:7, 13; 5:21</ref>).

H7003.name: Kitron
H7003.brief: A city in Zebulun not conquered
H7003.short: Kitron (Kartah or Kattath), a city in Zebulun that was not conquered by the tribe (<ref="Judges 1:30; Joshua 21:34, 19:15">Judges 1:30; Joshua 21:34, 19:15</ref>).
